violet: idea—add a 'forecast' action in Console to validate config flips (routing/quotas) before rollout?
arpit: yes. need sampled mirror + modeled fallback, plus clear CI gate.
juno: constraints: no user-visible duplication, scrub PII, region/tenant excludes, and show confidence intervals.
violet: API sketch:
```
POST /internal/config/forecast
{ "config_id": "quota_band_v2", "mode": "mirror", "sample_pct": 1, "window_mins": 20 }
```
arpit: telemetry: emit 'forecast_summary' with tags: config_id, mode, sample_pct, p95_delta_ms, err_delta_ppm, cost_delta_usd, conf_low, conf_high, sample_count -> stream to 'config-sim'.
juno: safety predicate: allow_rollout_if(forecast.p95_delta_ms < 15 && forecast.err_delta_ppm < 200 && forecast.cost_delta_pct < 5). expose in rollout API.
leandro: runner ownership: I'll own mirror runner + rate-limits and saturation probes. ops-bot: auto-pause if backend_saturation > 0.55.
violet: privacy: fallback to modeled mode when tenant consent absent; mask IDs and request bodies.
arpit: console: small modal + pass/fail badge and link to raw summary/audit id.
violet: I'll open RFC + small PR behind a runtime flag. any blockers?
juno: ping legal for GDPR consent wording; otherwise :thumbsup:
